description_en: Updates the remarks of a DNS record
description_zh: 根据传入参数修改解析记录的备注
name: UpdateDomainRecordRemark

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and the response. The default value is zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DNS record.<props="china"> Call the DescribeDomainRecords (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain the record ID.</props><props="intl"> Call the DescribeDomainRecords (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0) operation to obtain the record ID.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
解析记录的ID。<props="china">可通过调取DescribeDomainRecords (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取。</props>
<props="intl">可通过调取DescribeDomainRecords (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomainrecords?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)接口获取。</props>
parameters.name: record_id

parameters.help_en: The remarks for the DNS record. The default value is empty. If this parameter is left empty, the original remarks are deleted
parameters.help_zh: 您的解析记录的备注信息。默认为空，为空时删除原备注信息
parameters.name: remark
